articles.title: Create an account
articles.summary: Start a new workspace for your organization.
body: Select Create account, enter the name of your organization, your name, your email and a password of at least 12 characters, then select Create account.
Open the email "Confirm your Starter account" and select Confirm email. Then sign in.
If you see "Registration is closed.", ask the owner of your organization to invite you.

articles.title: Sign in
articles.summary: Open Starter with your email and password.
body: Enter your email and password and select Sign in. Select Keep me signed in to stay signed in on this device for two weeks.
If you see "The email or password is not correct.", check both and try again.
If you see "Confirm your email address before signing in.", open the confirmation email or select Send the link again.
If you see "Too many failed attempts. Try again later.", wait 15 minutes or reset your password.

articles.title: Reset your password
articles.summary: Choose a new password when you forgot the old one.
body: On the sign-in page select Forgot password, enter your email and select Send link.
Open the email "Reset your Starter password", select Choose a new password and enter the new password.
If you see "This link is invalid or has expired.", ask for a new link. A link works once and for one day.

articles.title: Sign out
articles.summary: End your session on this device.
body: Select Sign out in the header.
